title: Mini Pavlovas

ingredientGroups.title: Topping
items: Fresh fruit of choice, such as strawberries and kiwis

steps: Set the oven to 300°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Wipe the stand-mixer bowl with a little lemon or lime juice.
Add the egg whites, cream of tartar, vanilla, and salt to the clean mixer bowl. Whisk on medium-low until frothy.
Pulse the granulated sugar in a blender. With the mixer running, add the sugar a tablespoon at a time. Mix on high until stiff, glossy peaks form, scraping the bowl near the end.
Sprinkle the cornstarch over the meringue and fold it in with a spatula.
Spoon or pipe the meringue into 3-inch rounds. Create vertical swoops if desired, then make a shallow depression in each top with a teaspoon.
Put the meringues in the 300°F oven, immediately reduce the temperature to 225°F, and bake for 1 hour. They should be lightly cream-colored, dry, and firm outside with soft centers.
Turn off the oven and leave the door closed for 1 hour. Crack the door open for another hour. The meringues may be left in the oven overnight if humidity is a concern.
Whip the cold cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla on high until soft peaks form.
Assemble just before serving. Top the meringues with whipped cream, cut fruit, and mint.
